name: Chicken Breast in Creamy Mushroom Sauce
unmapped: chives (optional garnish; board has green-onions as substitute)
why: Pan-seared chicken cutlets in a mushroom-parmesan cream sauce; 571 cal / 42g protein / 12g carbs per serving - upper-mid band but comfortably under the 650 ceiling and 35g carb cap, with standout protein. Every core ingredient maps to the board (chicken-breast, mushrooms, white-wine, chicken-broth, heavy-cream, parmesan, butter, flour, garlic). Distinct from the slow-cooker creamy chicken-mushroom rice bowl already in catalog. Batch-scalable weigh-and-divide skillet.
